avis.titre: This WAS HG status, until my latest bottle.
avis.texte: I loved this serum - used it for over a year, multiple bottles, until my latest — it has a moldy, musty smell that the others did not. I know this isn't just me, either, as I've seen multiple reviews also complaining about it in the last month or two. It was so good before the latest batch; gave that brightening glow. I could tell if I skipped it two days in a row - my skin just didn't look as good as it usually would. My latest, smelly bottle (purchased within the month) has not worked in the same way the previous ones did. I don't know if its error, reformulation, ingredient switch, or what, but I'll be moving on to other niacinamide serums. I'm so disappointed because this is a very rare miss from Naturium, but I'm also not rubbing moldy scented goo on my face.
Immediately loving the feeling of this serum! It's newer in my lineup, Naturium is all I use! So far it's been a wonderful addition!
Iv been buying this for 3 months straight and my hormonal acne has completely gone away by now. I saw a noticeable difference after the first month.

I am in my mid 20's and looking into affordable skincare. My skin type is oily with a few dry patches. I have some dark acne scar/spots and still get the occasional zit. I can tell my skin is starting to age and I would also say my skin is pretty sensitive. Anyways, I got this and I apply it at night after I wash off my makeup. Sometimes I skip a night or two, but I would say I've been using this for about a month. I can tell this makes my face so smooth and gives it an overall better texture. I always wear concealer for my under eyes which are dark due to genetics and powder because my face gets oily, but I can tell my makeup goes on so much smoother too. This product hasn't caused me any breakouts and it doesn't my make my skin irritated at all. I know everyone's skin is different, but I would say give it a try and it can take time to tell visible results. I also use a moisturizer over this on some spots on my face and it mixes with my moisturizer just fine.

avis.titre: Better skin after a month of use

avis.titre: Naturium is now my holy grail!!
avis.texte: I am 42 with sensitive skin and hormonal acne. I have tried a lot of products and until now have only been able to use Charlotte Tilbury (didnt like the fragrance) and DIME Beauty. I consider skincare as an investment & will always spend whatever is needed to take care of my largest organ (which is also my 1st layer of defense). My mother has been drilling skincare and protection into me since my teens and I am so grateful that she did!! I constantly am told that I look 10-15yrs younger than I am, but I have never had the amount of complements about my skin as I've had since I started using all Naturium facial products (about 2 months ago). I wanted to share my skincare routine since I haven't found many reviews that have it spelled out (*please note: what works for me may/may not work for you): Morning: • Wash: Niacinaminde Cleansing Gelée • Tone: Niacinamide Essence • Serums: ~Vitamin C Complex Serum ~Niacinamide Serum 12% + Zinc 2% • Eye Cream: Plant Ceramide Rich Cream • Sunscreen: Dew-Glow SPF50++++ (original or tinted) ☆Once or twice a week exfoliate after wash: ~Skin Script Raspbery Scrub ~BHA Liquid ☆Once or twice a week use an ice roller ☆Once a month dermaplane/shave face Evening: • Remove Makeup: ~Naturium Cleansing Balm ~Micellar Water • Wash: Niacinaminde Cleansing Gelée • Tone: Niacinamide Essence • Eye Cream: Plant Ceramide Rich Cream ~Night #1 - Retinaldahyde 0.05% ~Night #2 - Vit C Super Serum Plus ~Night #3 - AHA Exfoliating Mask 10% ~Night #4 - Vit C Super

avis.titre: Go-to Serum for my Combination Skin
avis.texte: My skincare routine for my face consists mainly of Mad Hippie products. But when researching ingredients to hone in on my needs, I found this product. It has been a game changer for my combination face—oily t-zone with neutral or dry elsewhere. Mad Hippie products already containe niacinamide in their creams and lotions. But switching out the serum to this one made the across-the-board difference in my facial skin over 2-3 months: smoother, consistently hydrated, balanced oiliness even with my cycles, and at least some reduction of redness in my T-zone (possibly rosacea). Since that time I've tried other serums and face creams in my lineup over 1 1/2 years. But nothing gives quite the level of results when using the Naturium niacinnamide serum in my lineup.

I went to Ulta to find a treatment for my acne and came across this brand in front of the store. I recognized it from Hyram's recommendations on youtube. I'm so glad I tried it. After only a couple of weeks, my face is smooth, clear and even!
